author: Smoebo
generator: Grok Build command-line tool 1.0.60, image_gen, one call per plate with the prompt recorded here unchanged
subjectBasis: Original designs of generic roles, per docs/art/creature-art-guidance.md. The five fantasy roles are the SRD 5.1 NPC stat blocks of the same names; the ten mystery roles are the people of that genre's bestiary (src/lib/bestiary/mystery.json) who are what their card says. No published illustration or real person was named or supplied as an input.
encoding: Each 1024x1024 JPEG original resized once to 256x256 (cover) and encoded once to WebP quality 75 with sharp.
review: Each shipped plate was viewed at full size and in a round crop at 96px and 40px on dark and light surrounds. The baronet, the occultist and the fixer are second paintings: the first three sat on a near-black backdrop that swallowed dark clothing at 40px, and the first baronet read as a vampire.
